sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: One time when Jesus was teaching his disciples, he told them a story about how God’s kingdom grows. Jesus compared the work of God’s kingdom to a farmer working in his field.
Read
Luke 10:2
Mark 4:26–29 (The Parable of the Seed)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach

The ministry of Paul shows this teaching in action. First, Paul and his companions went to people who had never heard Jesus' story — like a farmer going to an empty field. Then they shared the story of Jesus — like sowing seed across that field. We cannot know who will believe, just as we cannot know which seeds will grow. Only God can make faith grow; our part is simply to share the good news. As a person's faith grows, we care for them like a young plant — this is making disciples. Finally, when the time is right, the farmer gathers the harvest — and we gather believers to form a new church. This picture helps us remember Jesus' teaching.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan

The farmer in Jesus' story is like a worker in God's kingdom. As we share the gospel and people believe, we should train them to do the same ministry. We go with them to help them learn, then entrust them to God's care and give them full authority for the work. This honors God, who is Lord of the Harvest.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends! To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Who can you take with you?
Pray
Lets ask God to send out many more laborers to join us in the harvest!
